payload.title: Multi-node job/projection workers (no duplicate execution)
payload.description: Make durable job workers and projection processing safe across N nodes using Postgres advisory locks / SELECT ... FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED. Also lift projection delta fan-out from in-process to cross-process over the cluster bus (operations.md:630-632), and add cross-process/post-restart Kafka idempotency (operations.md:492-495).
